name: Example Community Group
intro: This is a sample page. A real group would put its own welcome here, in its own words, for the people it wants to reach.
message: Here a group says who it is, who it serves and what it wants people to know. It can be as short or as long as the group likes.
Everything on this page is invented to show how a page looks. The group, the town, the events and the numbers are not real.

logo.alt: Sample logo: a circle with the word Example

announcements.title: A sample announcement
announcements.text: A group can post news here: a new program, a closing for the holidays, a call for volunteers.

events.title: Sample community meal
events.text: Events show their date, time and place. They drop off the page on their own once the date has passed.

events.title: Sample language circle
events.text: An event can link to a sign-up page or a map.

programs.name: Sample youth program
programs.text: A group lists what it runs, who can join and how to start.

programs.name: Sample elder lunch
programs.text: One or two plain sentences are enough.

help.text: A group can say how to give money, and what the money pays for.
Or ask for hands: drivers, cooks, people to help set up.
Or simply ask people to come to the next event.
A Native-owned business or artist can say where to buy.
Or ask people to pass the page along.
Or list exactly what is needed, and until when, so nobody sends things that are not wanted.
items: Sample item: winter coats, children's sizes

photos.caption: A group's own photos go here, with a caption it writes.

links.label: Sample link: the group's own website
